svg.title: Wireframe 4: dashboard and competitions on a phone
svg.desc: Six greyscale phone screens: dashboard with upcoming and recent competitions, a competition overview with its groups, the new competition form, the add group form with pace defaults, the empty first-use state and the list of all competitions.
svg.text: Wireframe 4 · Dashboard and competitions · phone (375 px)
Routes: / · /competitions · /competitions/new · /competitions/[id]. Greyscale layout only: colours, fonts and icons are placeholders. Names and numbers are made up.
A
Dashboard (/)
The coach's start page: upcoming competitions first, with
chips that open a group in one tap. The chip shows its phase.
Recent ones are a short list, All competitions has the rest.
Everything belongs to the active club.
B
Competition overview

g.text: Lifters are added on each group's page.

svg.text: One competition with its groups, phase and lifter count.
Tap a group to open its board. Edit changes name, dates
and place. Groups are added here, lifters on the group page.
C
New competition

g.text: Leave empty for a one-day competition

svg.text: Name and start date are required. The end date is only for
competitions over several days. Native date inputs work
best on phones. Everything is checked on the server too.
D
Add group

g.text: For example Group A, or Women 59 kg
Used for the T-minus until the real pace is measured.

svg.text: A group only needs a name. The pace defaults (75–90 s and
100–120 s) feed the T-minus until the measured pace takes
over, and are optional to change. Men and women can mix:
the 'allowed sex' setting is not shown yet (R14).
E
First use (empty state)

g.text: Create a competition, add a group and enter
the lifters. Then the board counts down for you.

svg.text: A new club sees one sentence and one button. The same
pattern is used for a competition without groups and
a group without lifters.
F
All competitions (/competitions)
Full list, newest first, grouped by year. The chips filter
All, Upcoming and Past. No search in the first slice.
